chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Munthir, from the one who mentioned it, from Furat ibn Ahnaf, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'For every fruit there is poison, so whenever you are given it, wipe it with water or immerse it in water, meaning wash it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on washing fruits before eating them according to hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a general principle that all fruits possess inherent 'poison' (sam), which Shia scholars interpret as either natural toxins, impurities, or spiritual subtleities requiring purification. He instructs believers to wash or immerse fruits in water before consumption, linking physical hygiene with ritual purity (taharah). This ruling underscores the Shia emphasis on combining practical health measures with religious observance in daily sustenance.
